response.sql: SELECT c.zoneref AS site_reference, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, COUNT(*) AS record_count, 1.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS fraction FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY c.zoneref, s.insurstat ORDER BY fraction DESC, s.insurstat IS NULL, c.zoneref LIMIT 10;
